ayahs.en: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe
ayahs.e2: Nũn. By the pen and what everyone writes

ayahs.en: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman
ayahs.e2: By the grace of your Lord, you ˹O Prophet˺ are not insane

ayahs.en: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted
ayahs.e2: You will certainly have a never-ending reward
ayahs.tr: Wa inna laka la ajran ghaira mamnoon

ayahs.en: And indeed, you are of a great moral character
ayahs.e2: And you are truly ˹a man˺ of outstanding character

ayahs.en: So you will see and they will see
ayahs.e2: Soon you and the pagans will see

ayahs.en: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil]
ayahs.e2: which of you is mad

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided
ayahs.e2: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided
ayahs.tr: Innaa Rabbaka Huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabeelihee wa Huwa a'lamu bilmuhtadeen

ayahs.en: Then do not obey the deniers
ayahs.e2: So do not give in to the deniers

ayahs.en: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you]
ayahs.e2: They wish you would compromise so they would yield ˹to you˺

ayahs.en: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
ayahs.e2: And do not obey the despicable, vain oath-taker
ayahs.tr: Wa laa tuti' kulla hallaa fim maheen

ayahs.en: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip
ayahs.e2: slanderer, gossip-monger

ayahs.en: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful
ayahs.e2: withholder of good, transgressor, evildoer

ayahs.en: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender
ayahs.e2: brute, and—on top of all that—an illegitimate child

ayahs.en: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children
ayahs.e2: Now, ˹simply˺ because he has been blessed with ˹abundant˺ wealth and children

ayahs.ar: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples
ayahs.e2: whenever Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables!”
ayahs.tr: Izaa tutlaa 'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen

ayahs.en: We will brand him upon the snout
ayahs.e2: We will soon mark his snout

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We have tested those ˹Meccans˺ as We tested the owners of the garden—when they swore they would surely harvest ˹all˺ its fruit in the early morning
ayahs.tr: Innaa balawnaahum kamaa balawnaaa As-haabal jannati iz 'aqsamoo la-yasri munnahaa musbiheen

ayahs.en: Without making exception
ayahs.e2: leaving no thought for Allah’s Will

ayahs.ar: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.en: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep
ayahs.e2: Then it was struck by a torment from your Lord while they slept
ayahs.tr: Fataafa 'alaihaa taaa'i fum mir rabbika wa hum naaa'imoon

ayahs.en: And it became as though reaped
ayahs.e2: so it was reduced to ashes

ayahs.en: And they called one another at morning
ayahs.e2: Then by daybreak they called out to each other

ayahs.ar: أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ
ayahs.en: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit
ayahs.e2: ˹saying,˺ “Go early to your harvest, if you want to pick ˹all˺ the fruit.”

ayahs.en: So they set out, while lowering their voices
ayahs.e2: So they went off, whispering to one another

ayahs.ar: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person
ayahs.e2: “Do not let any poor person enter your garden today.”

ayahs.en: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able
ayahs.e2: And they proceeded early, totally fixated on their purpose

ayahs.en: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost
ayahs.e2: But when they saw it ˹devastated˺, they cried, “We must have lost ˹our˺ way
ayahs.tr: Falammaa ra awhaa qaalooo innaa ladaaalloon

ayahs.en: Rather, we have been deprived
ayahs.e2: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.en: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]
ayahs.e2: The most sensible of them said, “Did I not urge you to say, ‘Allah willing.’?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum law laa tusabbihoon

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers
ayahs.e2: They replied, “Glory be to our Lord! We have truly been wrongdoers.”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo subhaana rabbinaaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen

ayahs.en: Then they approached one another, blaming each other
ayahs.e2: Then they turned on each other, throwing blame

ayahs.en: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors
ayahs.e2: They said, “Woe to us! We have certainly been transgressors
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo yaa wailanaaa innaa kunnaa taagheen

ayahs.ar: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
ayahs.en: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous
ayahs.e2: We trust our Lord will give us a better garden than this, ˹for˺ we are indeed turning to our Lord with hope.”
ayahs.tr: Asaa rabbunaaa any yubdilanaa khairam minhaaa innaaa ilaa rabbinaa raaghiboon

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew
ayahs.e2: That is the ˹way of Our˺ punishment ˹in this world˺. But the punishment of the Hereafter is certainly far worse, if only they knew
ayahs.tr: Kazaalikal azaab, wa la'azaabul aakhirati akbar; law kaanoo ya'lamoon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the righteous will have the Gardens of Bliss with their Lord

ayahs.en: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals
ayahs.e2: Should We then treat those who have submitted like the wicked

ayahs.en: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge
ayahs.e2: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

ayahs.en: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
ayahs.e2: Or do you have a scripture, in which you read

ayahs.en: That indeed for you is whatever you choose
ayahs.e2: that you will have whatever you choose

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge
ayahs.e2: Or do you have oaths binding on Us until the Day of Judgment that you will have whatever you decide
ayahs.tr: Am lakum aymaanun 'alainaa baalighatun ilaa yawmil qiyaamati inna lakum lamaa tahkumoon

ayahs.en: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible
ayahs.e2: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ which of them can guarantee all that

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُ فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.en: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful
ayahs.e2: Or do they have associate-gods ˹supporting this claim˺? Then let them bring forth their associate-gods, if what they say is true
ayahs.tr: Am lahum shurakaaa'u falyaatoo bishurakaaa 'ihim in kaanoo saadiqeen

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقࣲ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.en: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able
ayahs.e2: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Shin ˹of Allah˺ will be bared, and the wicked will be asked to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so
ayahs.tr: Yawma yukshafu 'am saaqinw wa yud'awna ilas sujoodi falaa yastatee'oon

ayahs.ar: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةࣱۖ وَقَدۡ كَانُواْ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمۡ سَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound
ayahs.e2: with eyes downcast, totally covered with disgrace. For they were ˹always˺ called to prostrate ˹in the world˺ when they were fully capable ˹but they chose not to˺
ayahs.tr: Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum zillatunw wa qad kaanoo yud'awna ilassujoodi wa hum saalimoon

ayahs.ar: فَذَرۡنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِۖ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know
ayahs.e2: So leave to Me ˹O Prophet˺ those who reject this message. We will gradually draw them to destruction in ways they cannot comprehend
ayahs.tr: Fazarnee wa many yukazzibu bihaazal hadeesi sanastad rijuhum min haisu laa ya'lamoon

ayahs.en: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm
ayahs.e2: I ˹only˺ delay their end for a while, but My planning is flawless
ayahs.tr: Wa umlee lahum; inna kaidee mateen

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down
ayahs.e2: Or are you asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt
ayahs.tr: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon

ayahs.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down
ayahs.e2: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺

ayahs.ar: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed
ayahs.e2: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not be like ˹Jonah,˺ the Man of the Whale, who cried out ˹to Allah˺, in total distress
ayahs.tr: Fasbir lihkmi rabbika wa laa takun kasaahibil boot; iz naadaa wa huwa makzoom

ayahs.ar: لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومࣱ‏
ayahs.en: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured
ayahs.e2: Had he not been shown grace by his Lord, he would have certainly been cast onto the open ˹shore˺, still blameworthy
ayahs.tr: Law laaa an tadaara kahoo ni'matum mir rabbihee lanubiza bil'araaa'i wa huwa mazmoom

ayahs.en: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous
ayahs.e2: Then his Lord chose him, making him one of the righteous

ayahs.ar: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad
ayahs.e2: The disbelievers would almost cut you down with their eyes when they hear ˹you recite˺ the Reminder, and say, “He is certainly a madman.”
ayahs.tr: Wa iny-yakaadul lazeena kafaroo la-yuzliqoonaka biabsaarihim lammaa saml'uz-Zikra wa yaqooloona innahoo lamajnoon

ayahs.en: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds
ayahs.e2: But it is simply a reminder to the whole world
ayahs.tr: Wa maa huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen
